newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight rates widen in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight rates widen in liquid market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound ranged from 9-7/8 to 10-5/16 percent in a liquid private sector market on Wednesday, widening from 9-3/4 to 10-1/4 on Tuesday, bankers said.
Several bankers said they did not perform any one-week transactions on the pound, but one said one-week rates ranged between 10-1/8 and 10-1/4, unchanged from Tuesday.
State-owned banks kept their minimum overnight lending rate at 10-1/2 percent, bankers said.
